column1: 同じ欄の「感度を計算 (効く部品の順)」を押します。部品を 1 つずつ 1% 動かして、MID がどれだけ動くかを効く順に並べます。電源 V1 は 1 (1% 上がると MID も 1% 上がる)、R1 と R2 は、同じ大きさで逆向きに効きます (10k と 10k なら R2 が +0.5、R1 が −0.5)。出力は電源にそのまま比例し、抵抗は比だけが効くので、電源の精度も抵抗の精度も大切だと分かります。
column2: Press "Sensitivity (parts by effect)" in the same section. It moves each part by 1% on its own and lists how far MID moves, strongest first. The supply V1 shows 1 (1% up on V1 is 1% up on MID); R1 and R2 act by the same amount in opposite directions (with 10k and 10k, R2 is +0.5 and R1 is −0.5). The output follows the supply directly and only the ratio of the resistors matters, so the accuracy of the supply and of the resistors both count

column1: # crates/app/src/samples.rs
電源の揺れを減らす (RC フィルタ + ツェナー)
column2: Reducing supply ripple (RC filter + zener)

column1: 9V の電源を、RC フィルタ (R1・C1) とツェナー (D1) で 5.1V にします。「解析」タブの「電源除去比 (PSRR)」で、揺らす電源を V1、見る点を VOUT にして計算すると、電源の揺れが VOUT にどれだけ届くかが周波数ごとに出ます (見る点を FILT にすると、フィルタだけの効き)。C1 や C2 を小さくして計算し直すと、揺れが届きやすくなるのが分かります
column2: Turns a 9V supply into 5.1V with an RC filter (R1, C1) and a zener (D1). In "Supply rejection (PSRR)" on the "Analysis" tab, choose V1 as the rippled supply and VOUT as the point, and compute: it shows per frequency how much of the supply ripple reaches VOUT (choose FILT to see the filter alone). Make C1 or C2 smaller and compute again to see more ripple get through
